headline: European Commission launches RAISE in-kind pledging initiative for AI-enabled science
summary: On 15 October 2026, the European Commission launched the RAISE AI in Science Enablers initiative for voluntary private and philanthropic support to European research. The Commission names seven initial participants and describes access to models, computing, software, data and training. Its pledge portal gives selected terms: Frontiers lists more than €1.6 million in services, including curation for 1,000 Horizon Europe datasets and 100 data-publication grants, while Google pledges $3 million in cloud credits/tokens. The portal also describes other contributions, including research collaborations, model/API access and compute. These remain announced commitments; there is no total valuation, common access framework, delivery record or researcher-uptake measure. A separate Mistral AI–CERN physics-model partnership is announced without technical specifications.
